title: Korean-American Soldier helps fight South Korea wildfire
description: Chief Warrant Officer 2 Johnta Daniel, Jacksonville, Florida native, UH-60 Blackhawk 2-2 Assault Helicopter Battalion, 2nd Combat Aviation Brigade, #2IDRUCD, felt a special connection, extinguishing the wildfires, 130 miles northeast of Seoul. “We’re honored to help the best we could.” #Second2None
keywords: Korean, Wildfire, Assault Helicopter, uh, 2ID/RUCD, Second2None, Johnta Daniel, South Korean Wild Fire, 2nd Infantry Division ROK, South Korea

transcript.text: - We were just kind of following the news
we got the WARNO that we may have to assist the
Koreans, and the Korean nationals, fighting the
forest fire.
We spoke to Col. Kim, he orchestrated the scheme of
maneuvers for both the U.S. and ROK UH-60s.
They had the National Forestry already on scene,
at which point we figured out the water positions,
and the positions for the aircraft to operate in,
upon reaching the scene of the fire it was approximately
3 square miles of just billowing smoke.
Course with the ROK-US alliance, it's something that
we always try to strengthen and improve on, it's just
this time, during a national crisis, we were able to
come here and, having trained with the ROK counterparts,
we were able to smoothly integrate into their plan,
execute as they requested.
I'm half Korean, my moms Korean, my sister was born here,
my dad was stationed here for several years,
I've been stationed here 6 years, between 2 tours,
so I know a lot of times you see it as U.S. and Korean
them and us, but for me, them is us, because it's
also my heritage and my nationality to some point,
even of course, you know went to America.
So to me that's just, to be able to help it's important,
it's also, to see those families and all the homes,
and the farmland just burning down.
To go out there and just to help, even if it's not a lot,
and maybe in the grand scheme of things,
we may feel like, even though we did a little part,
just to be out here to show that we are here to support
them, just for myself and my crew, that's something
that we're privileged to be able to even be a part of that
and honored to help the best we could.
